newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent down, NYMEX heat off near day's low.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent down, NYMEX heat off near day's low.

text.p: Brent February crude futures were lower in afternoon dealings in Asia, weighed down by API stock data overnight and chart factors.
February Brent on SIMEX last traded down nine cents from London at $24.50 per barrel. Volume was a healthy 2,069 lots, mostly crossed by one broker.
Brokers said overnight API statistics were moderately bearish on balance but the fundamentals of the market remained bullish.
API said distillate stocks rose 2.94 million barrels while crude stocks fell 9.5 million barrels. Both changes were greater than had been expected.
But brokers said they put more weight on the product stock changes because of the end-of-year practise of cutting crude stocks for tax reasons.
In addition, front-month Brent has hit chart resistance at $24.60-$24.73 -- the top of three chart cycles, they said.
